tool_plan.objective: Generate and preserve representative Chromium web-cache content for ChromeCacheView to list, preview, export, and extract.

required_actions.name: browser.launch
required_actions.why: Starts the Chromium source that creates Chrome cache entries.

required_actions.name: browser.goto
required_actions.why: Loads distinct documents and network resources into the cache.

required_actions.name: browser.get_clickables
required_actions.why: Observes visible controls before exercising cache-relevant page states.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_type
required_actions.why: Generates search or form requests with distinct query content.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_click
required_actions.why: Follows visible links or results to fetch additional cacheable resources.

required_actions.name: browser.click
required_actions.why: Commits observed page controls and state changes.

required_actions.name: browser.select_option
required_actions.why: Varies observed finite page parameters that can change fetched content.

required_actions.name: browser.scroll
required_actions.why: Reveals lazy-loaded content and its associated network resources.

required_actions.name: browser.screenshot
required_actions.why: Preserves visible-state evidence corresponding to cached content.

required_actions.name: browser.close
required_actions.why: Closes the source browser so pending cache data can be finalized.

completion.detail: Complete only after Chromium has been closed and chromium.cache.cache_data is present for analysis by ChromeCacheView.

tool_plan.action_intent_guidance: Action Flow: Launch Chromium, then use browser.goto with relevant run-provided runtime resources when available. Prefer ordinary, visibly interactive pages that load documents plus images, styles, scripts, media, or other embedded resources. On each page, use browser.get_clickables before interacting. Use browser.smart_type in visible search or form fields when available, then browser.smart_click or browser.click on observed controls or results to load additional cacheable responses. Use browser.select_option for observed page choices that visibly alter displayed or fetched content. Use browser.scroll to reveal lazy-loaded material; after each bounded reveal, use browser.get_clickables again and interact only with newly observed relevant controls. Capture browser.screenshot for representative loaded states. Visit a few distinct runtime-provided resources or visible page states, then browser.close to finalize cache writes. The target artifact is generated by normal browsing activity that fetches cacheable documents and subresources.
